verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a self-serve account export: its Marketing API can generate a new account export or download a finished one (docs-16). A community user confirms exporting their subscriber list themselves (comm-13). The evidence does not say what the export contains or what format it uses, so coverage of custom fields, tags, engagement history and the suppression list is unproven. Missing for 10: documented export of custom fields, tags, engagement history and the suppression/unsubscribe list, confirmation of an open format such as CSV, and independent hands-on confirmation that the export is complete.
